cache.accountListsDescription: Cached for 10 minutes. Chart of Accounts rarely changes, so longer TTL provides significant performance improvement.
cache.salesPurchasesDescription: Cached for 2 minutes. Short TTL ensures data freshness for frequently-changing transactional data.
